// REQ: LANG-2951 LANG-2952 LANG-2953 LANG-2954
class Greeter extends Actor;
var() string GreetName;
/* Greets on spawn */
simulated event PostBeginPlay()
{
    local int i;
    Super.PostBeginPlay();
    for (i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        Log("Hello, " $ GreetName $ "!");
}
defaultproperties
{
    GreetName="world"
}
